news.title: American Doctor With Ebola Says He Is ‘Optimistic’ for Recovery
news.summary: Dr. Peter Stafford, a medical missionary in the Democratic Republic of Congo, tested positive for Ebola on Sunday. He is receiving treatment in Germany.
